notes.title: Join us for a Reddit AMA at 3 PM EST (+ giveaway!)
notes.content:
Join developers @Nintendrew_ and @morningstar_gs on r/NintendoSwitch this afternoon for an AMA! We'll be answering all of your questions about #indiedev and giving away 3 copies of C.A.R.L. Don't miss it!

http://reddit.com/r/NintendoSwitch
